responsibility: Contains the i386 machine-description fragment for synchronization and atomic-memory operations. It defines the unspec codes and RTL expanders/insns for fences such as lfence, sfence, and mfence, plus atomic load/store and read-modify-write patterns, compare-and-exchange style atomics, and newer locking primitives like CMPccXADD and RAOINT so the backend can lower GCC atomic builtins and memory-ordering operations to x86 instructions.
